description: Display-only mapping of segments.<segment>.stenosis_pct to the % shown in the report (display_pct) and its category (display_category). stenosis_pct, prob_significant and every flag are unchanged.
rules: otherwise: linear interpolation through the knots, rounded to an integer
significant flag: never shown as normal; an estimate below zero_below_pct is shown at the first display knot (20%, mild)

provenance.dataset_short: the MHI held-out test split (3,321 studies, 59,778 segment readings), 5-fold patient cross-validated
provenance.dataset: MHI held-out test split (Split = inference of the DeepCORO-CLIP report labels): 3,321 studies, 18 segments each, labels 0/20/40/50/70/80/95/100% from the angiography report. Predictions: DeepCORO-JEPA v12 on the full test set from DICOM (NAS DeepCoro_Integrated/verification_2026-11-10/v12_test_dicom_predictions.parquet), because the v13 full-test predictions are kept on the training server only. v13 check: on the 120 test studies run with v13 (verification_2026-11-12_v13/out_avi.csv) the same mapping gives T0 PPV 0.54 / NPV 0.91 and weighted kappa 0.60 (v12 on the same studies 0.58).
provenance.method: T0: upper end of the plateau of Youden's J (within 0.002 of the maximum) for report stenosis > 0%, pooled over the 18 segments. Knots 30/50/70: estimate cuts that maximise the quadratic-weighted kappa of the 5 categories (0, <30, 30-49, 50-69, >=70), 1-point grid; the display value at T0 is the report's mild label (20%). Rules chosen by 5-fold cross-validation grouped by patient (fit on 4 folds, scored on the 5th); the shipped values are the fit on all folds, rounded to integers (CV folds: T0 10-10.5, knots 23-27.5 / 36-40 / 46-49.5).
